bio.text: Deb Haaland is the Democratic nominee for governor of New Mexico in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served as U.S. Secretary of the Interior under President Joe Biden, and was previously a member of Congress and chair of the Democratic Party of New Mexico.
Haaland is a member of Laguna Pueblo.
